rootCauses: Native diskDensityTransform decoded an original without charging it while invoking the addressed decision. The production fix tracks/releases each original through existing RowOwnership.

Native density candidate estimation omitted the old path transient retry contract. The production fix applies the existing compression retry policy over the same pinned candidate, with unchanged attempts/delays.
Equal-position spans were stably sorted after replacements had already been appended before removals. Append removal spans before replacement spans so overlap merge preserves the removed reason.

Identical row digests show native seed admission already accounts 795/12743 tokens at 512/8192 rows, while old direct-recorder admission accounts zero. Preserve admitted tokens plus offset and measure no-read acquisitions relative to entry; use explicit context room and a genuinely over-discounted clamp input.
High-density rollback used a JSONL-only recorder; select the real recorder protocol, seed awaited addBatch, retain old zero-baseline cases explicitly old and add admitted native no-op/failure cases.
The type contract checked removed MiddleOutStrategy.compress instead of its current public compressDisk entrypoint. Original absence-of-optimize assertions remain via the strategy interface.
